name: Accurate
desc: Accuracy is increased by 25%

name: Adept
desc: Using a skill increases your critical hits chance by 7.5% for 15 seconds

name: Ambusher
desc: Increase your damage by 10% against targets in cover

name: Balanced
desc: Weapon acquires maximum accuracy faster when shouldered

name: Brutal
desc: Headshot damage is increased by 12% when using this weapon

name: Capable
desc: Using a skill improves the handling of your weapon for 15 seconds

name: Commanding
desc: Every kill performed while the signature skill is active extends its duration by 20%

name: Competent
desc: Weapon damage is increased by 10% for 15 seconds after using a skill

name: Coolheaded
desc: Performing a headshot reduces all skill cooldowns by 5%

name: Deadly
desc: Critical hit damage is increased by 15%

name: Disciplined
desc: Killing a target makes your next shot with the weapon be an automatic critical hit

name: Destructive
desc: Armor destruction value is increased by 15% when using this weapon

name: Determined
desc: Killing a target reduces skill cooldowns by 7.5%

name: Dominant
desc: Every kill while your Signature Skill is active reduces the cooldown of your other skills by 10%

name: Elevated
desc: Increase your damage by 10% when elevated more than 1.2 meters above your target

name: Expert
desc: This weapon deals 100% more damage when the target is below 30% health

name: Ferocious
desc: Damage against elite and named enemies is increased by 10%

name: Fierce
desc: Critical hit chance is increased by 5% when using this weapon

name: Focused
desc: When no skills are on cooldown, your weapon damage is increased by 10%

name: Harmful
desc: Each hit has a 15% chance to apply the Bleed status effect

name: Hurried
desc: Critical hits increase reload speed by 10% to a minimum of 1 seconds reload time

name: Intense
desc: The first bullet of a magazine has a 25% chance to apply the On Fire status effect to the target

name: Meticulous
desc: Killing a target has a 25% chance to instantly refill the magazine

name: Predatory
desc: Killing a target regenerates 35% health over 20 seconds

name: Prepared
desc: Damage is increased by 15% when more than 30 meters from the target

name: Proficient
desc: The first bullet shot when out of combat has a 50% bonus chance to result in a critical hit

name: Responsive
desc: Damage is increased when closer than 10 meters to the target

name: Self-Preserved
desc: Critical hits with this weapon heal the user for 3% of damage dealt

name: Skilled
desc: Headshot kills with this weapon increase signature skill resources by 5%

name: Sustained
desc: Killing a target increases your health by 6%

name: Swift
desc: Reloading is 25% faster

name: Talented
desc: Killing a target with this weapon increases your Skill Power by 15% for 20 seconds. The effect does not stack. Killing a new target refreshes the timer.

name: Toxic
desc: Headshots with this weapon have a 15% chance to apply the Blind status effect

name: Trained
desc: Critical hits increase signature skill resources by 0.10%

name: Unforgiving
desc: Missing health segments increase your damage: 1 missing segment +10%, 2 missing segments +25%

name: Vicious
desc: Critical hit chance is increased by 10% while having more than two segments of health

name: Cover Shooter
desc: Every bullet fired at an enemy from cover increases weapon damage by 0.5% up to 50%. The bonus lasts for 10 seconds. Getting a kill with this weapon while in cover resets the duration. The bonus damage is cancelled by reloading, swapping weapons, or exiting combat.

name: Boomstick
desc: Double trigger fires off both barrels in short succession

name: Caduceus
desc: Each Critical hit heals you and your group for 1% of your Skill Power. Can only heal each player once every 0.2 seconds.

name: Card Counter
desc: One half of the magazine does 20% increased damage. The half which deals increased damage flips after 15 seconds or when the magazine is empty.

name: Carefree
desc: Hipfire damage is increased by 11%

name: Center Mass
desc: Shoots heavy slugs instead of buckshot

name: Distracted
desc: Your damage is increased by 18% against targets with status effects

name: Fire
desc: Headshots increase stability by 30% for 15 seconds. Body shots increase headshot damage by 30% for 15 seconds.

name: Fury
desc: Hitting weak points increases weapon damage by 15% for 15 seconds. Hitting skill proxies increase critical hit damage by 30% for 15 seconds.

name: Glutton
desc: Killing a target increases your Damage dealt 10% until you stop firing. Multiple kills stack this bonus up to 5 times.

name: Golden Rhino
desc: Increase stagger by 200%

name: History Repeats
desc: Each Bullet embeds itself in the target and detonates 1 second later for 700% of your Firearms total

name: Lights Out
desc: Destroying an enemy weak point resets skill cooldowns for you and your nearby group members. Can happen once every 10 seconds.

name: Midas
desc: Each Bullet you hit with reduces your damage by 1% and your target's damage by 1% to a max of 20%. The effect is reduced by 5% per second.

name: Pakhan
desc: Each kill makes the next reload have 20% extra bullets compared to its base

name: Quickdraw
desc: When drawn weapon damage is increased by 20% for 2 seconds. After that weapon damage is decreased by 20%.

name: Showstopper
desc: Your accuracy with this weapon is increased the fewer shells you have left in the magazine

name: Uncomplicated
desc: Damage is increased by 15%, accuracy and stability mods reduce this bonus.

name: Play Rough
desc: Damage taken is reduced by 20% while firing. The taken damage is applied when you stop firing.
